meta.privacy: All texts are anonymised and adapted; they contain no user identity or live operational claim.

samples.source_note: Anonymised and adapted from a public-transport disruption notice style.
samples.text: 東鐵綫紅磡至會展之間懷疑發生信號故障，雙向列車服務暫停，消息仍待核實。

samples.source_note: Anonymised and adapted from a passenger report style.
samples.text: 有乘客報告東鐵綫列車在九龍塘站發生列車故障，往金鐘方向服務受阻。

samples.source_note: Anonymised and adapted from a station announcement style.
samples.text: 旺角東站廣播指一列東鐵綫列車出現車門故障，往大圍方向列車行駛緩慢。

samples.source_note: Anonymised and adapted from a service alert style.
samples.text: 東鐵綫大圍至九龍塘之間有未經核實的供電故障報告，列車服務暫停。

samples.source_note: Anonymised and adapted English passenger-report style.
samples.text: An unverified report says East Rail Line trains between Hung Hom and Exhibition Centre are delayed in both directions.

samples.source_note: Anonymised and adapted English service-alert style.
samples.text: East Rail Line service from Exhibition Centre to Admiralty is suspended towards Admiralty; confirmation is pending.
未經核實的現場消息稱紅磡站東鐵綫月台非常擁擠，列車服務仍然運作。

samples.source_note: Anonymised and adapted weather-impact report; not an official warning.
samples.text: 受暴雨影響，有報告指東鐵綫大圍至九龍塘列車行駛緩慢，尚待官方確認。
有人說金鐘站情況不尋常，但沒有提供路線、方向或故障資料。

samples.source_note: Anonymised denial used to test conservative extraction.
samples.text: 站內廣播表示東鐵綫紅磡至會展之間沒有信號故障，也沒有列車延誤。
